messages:
rotbot: ALERT: Customer-impacting TLS handshake failures observed for private deployment control-plane connections starting 03:41 UTC. Affects some private VPC agent heartbeats and admin console sessions. Incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2740005678 :rotating_light:

ashley: seeing intermittent x509: certificate signed by unknown authority errors from private-agent->control-plane in eu-west-2 and us-west-2. Rate ~2-3%. stack: `tls: failed to verify certificate chain`

diego: oncall: recent cert-rotation job ran 03:30 and attempted to replace intermediate certs in the key-rotation pipeline. pausing rotation now. `kubectl annotate job/cert-rotation paused=true -n control-plane`

mira: rolling back the rotation artifacts to the previous bundle and reloading CA on affected control-plane replicas. command: `./ctl reload-ca --bundle /artifacts/ca_bundle_prev.pem --region all`

ops-eng: mitigation steps applied:
- paused scheduled cert-rotation pipeline
- rolled back to previous CA bundle across control-plane replicas
- forced full TLS renegotiation on agents (graceful) to pick up old certs
- increased control-plane ingress retry window and 504->retry mapping for private agents

ashley: customer impact: intermittent control-plane disconnects for private-agent heartbeats causing brief ~30-90s reconcilation delays; no model inference plane data exposed. tagging affected tenants for proactive outreach.

support: draft customer broadcast created: "We detected intermittent connectivity issues between agents and the control plane due to a certificate rotation. We paused the rotation and restored previous certificates; agents should reconnect automatically. We're monitoring and will follow up." Will send after 10 minutes of stability.

diego: logs copied to incident artifacts: s3://incidents/2740005678/logs and flamegraphs to /incidents/2740005678/diag. Captured failing TLS handshakes and rotation job traces.

mira: observed immediate drop in TLS errors after rollback on canary replicas. p99 reconnect time improved from ~120s to ~25s on those hosts. expanding rollback to all replicas now.

ops-eng: planned next steps:
- full rollback completion (expected 5m)
- run validation job to check cert chain against older CA bundle across regions
- harden rotation job: verify intermediate cert chain and add a pre-check that ensures agents accept the new bundle in a canary cohort before global rollout
- create postmortem and add an automatic pause on rotation if agent error rate >0.5% within 3m

ashley: incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2740005678 (includes customer list and troubleshooting checklist).

support: standing by for customer replies; enterprise accounts alerted for direct outreach.

diego: monitoring: errors down to baseline on all rolled-back replicas. continuing to watch 15m. will update when we close.

rotbot: Broadcast scheduled to #customers-facing in 8m with summary and mitigation steps.

mira: post-incident items: ENG-8420 (rotation preflight checks), ENG-8421 (agent acceptance test for new CA bundles), OPS-333 (add runbook step to validate chain on canary).

ashley: closing update: rollback complete, connectivity stable. if anyone sees regressions, ping `@oncall` and append traces to the incident artifacts. :white_check_mark:
